scope: Only the four candidate episodes in this live synthetic batch; verified lessons are outside this review.
method: Read generated claims and retained observations, including statement/applies_when/limitations and evidence quotes.
Compare quoted and cited facts against projected evidence and complete synthetic fixture traces.
Check candidate lessons remain empty and observed content is identical to generated content except the namespaced claim id.
limitations: A successful hard contract does not establish semantic accuracy of every generated clause.
This adjudication does not modify the raw model response, live report, production code or formal memory.
No network or additional model call was used.

summary.conclusion: All candidate outputs remained inferred observations with no admitted lessons. retry-still-failed contains one unsupported no-verification assertion because the failed retry is omitted from the projection. report-timeout-budget accurately reports temporal association and withholds causality, but its applies_when condition should be restricted to the observed configuration and outcome.
